newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks firm but drifts in low volume.
newsitem.headline: French stocks firm but drifts in low volume.

text.p: French shares held the morning's positive tone but traders said business was becalmed with London closed for a market holiday.

Among actives, Accor was up 1.75 percent and denied an agency report it was looking to sell its U.S. Motel 6 chain. Paribas, up 3.33 percent, benefits from a broker upgrade, citing its focus on international banking.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 8.19 points or 0.31 percent at 2,663.50 at 1123 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up 11 at 2,649 from Friday's close.
